note: An ACCEPT-mode delegation: the pending entry ends with a DELEGATE: block, the helper results go under the Stage 5 name, and the re-spawned PM issues its verdict as a normal PASS entry.

cites.text: **PM — Accept (pending):** the PM needed delegated work or a user decision before it could decide. Run its `DELEGATE:` block and append the results
The orchestrating session appends your results to the log under `## Delegated — <requesting stage>`.
A PM continued or re-spawned after a `## PM — Accept (pending)` delegation does not extend that entry: it issues the verdict as a normal `## PM — PASS` or `## PM — FAIL` entry.

resume.next: hand back to the user: the PM's archive or clear did not finish
resume.via: row: `## PM — PASS` in any other run
